Body.Content:
Business value

Onboarding in Dynamics 365 Human Resources spans several pages and two people: HR administrators hire the candidate, enroll leave and set compensation, while the new employee completes personal details, address, emergency contacts and identification. Steps are easy to miss.

A new agentic onboarding experience will brings the tasks into one guided conversation over live Human Resources data. Every change is previewed and confirmed explicitly, and all reads and writes run under the signed-in user's security roles and legal entities, so teams move faster without giving up control.

Capability details

Ready-to-start worklist: unprocessed candidates whose estimated start date falls in the configured trigger lead-days window, across the HR manager's legal entities.

Guided hire: opens the standard Hire new worker dialog with real lookup values (worker type, employment type, dates, position, personnel number, checklist templates), then creates the worker and re-reads the result.

Start date adjustment, leave plan enrollment and fixed compensation, each confirmed and read back, plus a read-only onboarding status view.

New employee self-service: own checklist grouped overdue, pending and done, plus personal details, home address, emergency contacts and identification.

Identification capture: the employee uploads a passport, license, national ID or work permit image; the agent proposes the type, number, issuing country and dates, masks the number and requires confirmation. The image is not retained.

Also included: natural-language address entry, progress summary, an introductory email draft and resource links.

Enablement

Configured per legal entity in Human resources parameters: the Copilot HR manager toggle and Copilot trigger lead days drive the candidate worklist. Administrator capabilities require the Human resource manager or assistant role; employee capabilities run under self-service access

GA date: July CY2027

Preview date: March CY2027
